Common questions

Before we get started

How quickly can my website be ready?

Most focused local-business sites can be prepared within one to two weeks after we receive your content, photos, and feedback. The exact schedule is confirmed before work begins.

Do I own the finished website?

Yes. After the final payment, the approved website files and business-specific content belong to you. Any third-party services remain subject to their own terms.

What if I do not have good photos or written content?

We can help organize and polish the information you already have. If professional photography or specialized writing is needed, we will discuss that before adding any cost.

Are hosting and the domain included?

Domain registration and third-party service fees are separate, so they stay in your name and under your control. We can handle the technical connection for you.
